item.tib: bskang bshags rin chen gter rgyun zhes bya ba'i dbu mas gzigs phyogs
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags dpa' bo bdun bsgrab gyis (sgrub kyi/)bskangs (skong) bshags gnad kyi lde mig 'di/ sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba dang / sgrub gshen chags nyams bskang ba'i phyir/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs bcud bsdus/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
